Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

us.description:
Astrea is a DICE-deck-building roguelike that flips the script on deckbuilders by using dice instead of cards and an unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption.

Features

• Unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption - In Astrea there is a new type of “damage” system. Purification can be used to damage enemies or heal yourself. On the other hand, corruption can be used to damage yourself or heal the enemies. Pacify enemies through Purification, or Corrupt yourself to unleash abilities that help tip the scales.
• Dynamic Health Bar system - With skills attached to your health bar, you can take Corruption to enable these skills and unleash powerful abilities. But be careful, if you take too much Corruption you will be consumed by it.
• Not cards, but dice! - Build a dice pool that fits your playstyle. Choose from over 350 dice and three dice types; reliably safe, perfectly balanced, or powerfully risky. A dice type system designed with high-risk, high-reward in its core.
• Customize your dice - Forge your fate by editing die faces with new actions, tipping the odds of powerful results into your favor.
• Choose from Six Brave Oracles - Each possessing their own unique dice sets, abilities, and playstyles. From ingenious spellcasters to brutish berserkers, whether you like beating the opponent into submission or outsmarting them with clever plays, there’s an oracle for you.
• Uncover over 170 modifying Blessings - Imbue your Oracle with unique passives yielding potent effects that changes up your fundamental tactics. Choose between Star Blessings, passive effects with lower power, or Black Hole Blessings, powerful passive effects with a drawback.

Dominate the dungeon. Or let it dominate you.
A turn-based deckbuilding roguelite — Dungeon Merge.
Every run, a different strategy. A different hero. A different ending.

■ A Cast of Unique Heroes — Not just stronger stats. A completely different game.
Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count.
Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash area devastation. Defense is offense.
Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy.
Noble: +1 level-up choices, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon.

Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain
Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row
Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot
Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legend. Upgrade mid-combat.

Chalice: Die once, revive at 50% HP
Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP
Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices rise 25%
Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP every time you enter a shop

■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die.
Treasure Goblin: Escape in 7 turns if you don't kill it fast enough
Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn
Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand
Multiple bosses, each with unique phases and attack patterns

■ Seal System — The real game starts here.
Normal mode is just the beginning. The true challenge unlocks with the Seals.
Mix and match Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty.
Only a handful of players will ever clear the hardest combination.

■ Endless Replayability
3 regions × 17 floors — procedurally generated every run
Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types
Different maps, enemy combos, and card drops every time

■ Features
Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding
Diverse heroes, skills, relics, and enemies
Seal System — design your own difficulty with Trials and Contracts
Procedurally generated dungeons
6 languages supported — Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, German, French
Cloud save
Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy.
One run is never enough.
